note: The Santa Clara County Registrar of Voters statement of vote for the June 8, 2010 election lists the nonpartisan City of San Jose Mayor contest. Chuck Reed received 103230 of 134320 candidate votes (76.9 percent), a majority, so the primary decided the office. Winner and runner-up are in san_jose_results.json.

Measure B full text (opened as a PDF through an Internet Archive copy of the city file) amends Charter section 1600(a): the election for Mayor is held every four years beginning with 1994, and beginning in 2024 on the same four-year cycle as the presidential election. Charter sections 402 and 500 state that the Mayor term beginning January 1, 2023 is two years ending December 31, 2024, to move the mayoral election to the presidential year beginning in 2024. Mayoral elections therefore fall in 2010, 2014, 2018, 2022 and 2024, then 2028. The 2022 election filled the two-year term that began in 2023.

The Santa Clara County Registrar of Voters results site (Clarity) for the November 8, 2022 general election lists the City of San Jose Mayor runoff between Matt Mahan and Cindy Chavez. The June 7, 2022 primary on the same site shows no majority winner (Chavez 65501 of 167403 votes, 39.1 percent, Mahan 54076), so the runoff decided the office. Only the runoff is in san_jose_results.json. Charter section 1600 provides a runoff between the top two primary candidates and requires a majority. The 2022 election filled the two-year term that began January 1, 2023.

The mayor elected in 2022 serves the two-year term ending December 31, 2024. The county results index lists no San Jose mayoral contest in 2023 (the November 7, 2023 special election).

Measure B moved the mayoral election to 2024. The Santa Clara County Registrar of Voters results site (Clarity) for the March 5, 2024 presidential primary lists the City of San Jose Mayor contest. Matt Mahan received 144701 of 167064 candidate votes (86.6 percent), a majority, so the primary decided the office under Charter sections 500 and 1600(g). No mayoral runoff appears on the November 5, 2024 county results index. Winner and runner-up are in san_jose_results.json.
